votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of July 8, 2025, as well as the formal meeting minutes for September 2, 2025.
votes.description: The Council approved the official minutes for the July 8, 2025 work session and the September 2, 2025 formal meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Resolution 39 of 2025 declaring November as Native American Heritage Month in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: The Council adopted a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing November as Native American Heritage Month, acknowledging Indigenous lands and the City's commitment to justice and shared prosperity.

The Council approved all four consent items: setting a TEFRA public hearing date for Sky Harbour Hangar Development, setting a public hearing date for Budget Amendment No. 3 for FY 2025-26, setting a public hearing date for the Valley Behavioral Health Public Benefit Analysis resolution, and approving the board appointment of Parviz Faiz to the Community Development and Capital Improvement Programs Advisory Board.
